notes: Plan 6.1: one species trophy per species, identical everywhere. Monster figurines (FIG) are used wherever the species has one, because a figurine is the clearest possible species link (owner rule 2026-10-08: a figurine is fine when its creature is present in our game; every figurine species here is spawned by the shard, see Species-In-Game.md). Species with no figurine use lair pieces that evoke them: orc captain and orc lord take the rust-red war banners, the mummy a sarcophagus, the black bear a bearskin rug. 52 species. Still without a main-catalog figurine (the era-neutral section has some, ids CN-FIG-...): imp, orcish mage, wyvern, ancient wyrm, kraken, hell hound and the other dungeon creatures; using era-neutral ids in pools needs an owner decision. Gazer and giant spider rest on grade C art (their creature dates are unverified), and the drake reuses the jade dragon figurine, so it looks like a dragon; the owner may prefer to drop those three.
